sonnet.problem: The card tells only verse 23, the seed Joseph hands out. It cites Genesis 47:14-23, which is far wider than what it tells. The 'money, livestock and land' line only glances back at verses 14, 17 and 20, so those verses are not told here.
sonnet.rule: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
